source_instruction: i'm looking for certifies organic groceries the flavor was cacao bits
query: I spent twenty minutes this morning chasing my escaped house gecko around the apartment, he’d climbed up the curtain rod and knocked over my favorite pothos cutting right onto the rug. I stopped on the way in to grab a lavender iced latte that was way too sweet, and I still have to remember to pick up dry cleaning after this. My roommate texted me five times while I was walking in to rant about our building’s broken elevator that’s been out for three whole days. Can you help me find certified biodynamic cacao nibs under $20 in this non-dairy milks section?
